description: Inspect an OpenPGP public key (ASCII-armored or base64 binary) the way gpg --show-keys does, offline: primary key and subkey fingerprints and key IDs (v4, v5 and RFC 9580 v6 keys), algorithm and size / curve (RSA, DSA, ElGamal, ECDSA, ECDH, EdDSA, Ed25519 / Ed448, X25519 / X448), creation and expiry from the self-signatures, revocations, capabilities (certify / sign / encrypt / authenticate), user IDs split into name / email / comment, preferred algorithms and features, the armor CRC-24 check and Web Key Directory (WKD) URLs for each email. Flags weak or deprecated keys, SHA-1 self-signatures, expired keys and keys without an encryption subkey. Private key blocks are refused. Price: $0.002 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/pgp-key-info

key.description: ASCII-armored public key block or base64 of the binary key

now.description: Unix time for expiry checks (default: now)

name: pgp_key_info
title: Pgp Key Info
